links.outcome: Hallucination rate of evidence-constrained corrective RAG versus Vanilla RAG
links.effect: Hallucination Rate 0.11, a 71% relative reduction over Vanilla RAG; Evidence Citation Rate 0.87; all pairwise comparisons with baselines p < 0.001 (McNemar's test).
links.quote: Evaluated on 200 held-out test queries drawn from the harmonized corpus, MMCRAG-Resp achieved a Clinical Precision@10 of 0.81, a Hallucination Rate of 0.11 (71% relative reduction over Vanilla RAG), a Spirometry Alignment Score of 0.79, and an Evidence Citation Rate of 0.87.

unlisted_practices: Physiology-aware relevance scoring gating retrieved evidence before LLM consumption (corrective RAG)
Local small language model deployment without GPU for privacy-preserving inference

screen.reason: The study develops and empirically evaluates a corrective multi-modal RAG safeguard (evaluating evidence gating and citation against standard vanilla RAG) to mitigate hallucinations and improve clinical alignment.

primary.practice: corrective retrieval-augmented generation and evidence gating
